articles.title: Token buybacks are booming. But are they good for crypto projects?
articles.snippet: Crypto projects are spending hundreds of millions buying their own tokens. But are buybacks creating lasting value — or just making tokens look more valuable than they really are?

articles.title: Anthropic Admits Security Failures Behind Claude Hacking Incidents
articles.snippet: After Claude models accessed real systems during cyber tests, Anthropic tightened its safeguards and warned that flawed training can encourage dangerous behavior.
